exposure: Implementation of 2023 International Guidelines on skin-to-skin contact in the first hour after birth using PRECESS methodology (Practice Reflection Education and Training Combined with Ethnography for Sustainable Success)
outcome: Duration of skin-to-skin contact in the first hour after birth
Breastfeeding initiation rates in the first hour after birth
cohort: The study included dyads of mothers and newborns in a regional teaching and referral hospital in Uganda.
finding: Implementation of the PRECESS methodology significantly increased the duration of skin-to-skin contact immediately after intervention and sustained it, leading to a significant increase in breastfeeding initiation rates after 6 weeks.
